summary: Packet E Step 3 verification (PDF mock 'samay nikal gaya'/missed-time rule). Re-ran the builder's picture_late242 suite (19/19 PASS) and the browser walk ui_picture239 via picture_bridge239 on the real preview frontend at desktop 1920x800 and mobile 390x844 (50/50 PASS, incl. all Step-3 UI assertions: chip 'Draft · samay nikal gaya', switch Off + enabled, data-testid='mock-missed-<id>' line, Live karo without reload, no horizontal overflow). Wrote a new EDGE HUNT suite /app/backend/tests/picture_late_edge243.py covering the 7 requested edges end-to-end: older doors (books/{id}/control action publish_ready, and /api/admin/publish-ready); Library move + restore preserves missed_at and Live still works; reviewer rejection (403) on all three owner doors; miss by only 1-2 seconds; paused/library books not touched by missed_time; healthy case emits zero miss audits; repeated Dobara chalao after miss is idempotent (no second audit, no pictures sent). TOTAL new edges: 19 PASS 0 FAIL. No application code was modified. Isolation rules honoured: disposable tejas_isolated_* DB only, mongod nofile raised, Supabase faked via Leaky at HTTP wire, Emergent in memory, one suite at a time, DB name guarded before drop.
critical_code_review_comments: book_publish.missed_time() is called twice inside publish_ready (lines 425 + 439), once BEFORE any picture is cut and once AFTER proven(). This neatly covers both 'waiting for pictures' and 'saving took too long'; verified end-to-end (A/C in picture_late242, a1/a2 in picture_late_edge243).

The miss gate correctly excludes: series papers, mocks without release_at, release_override mocks, and any mock whose release_at is still in the future - matched exactly by the condition `if series or not mock.publish_requested or not mock.release_at or mock.release_override or await database_now()<mock.release_at: return False`. Paused books are pre-filtered at publish_ready top (`if book.paused: return`). Library-archived mocks are pre-filtered by mocks_for(). Edge e verified both.

missed_at is cleared idempotently and symmetrically in all three owner doors: master.mock_status() → request_publication() sets missed_at=None, book_imports.control() action publish_ready sets missed_at=None, and structure.publish_ready_items() goes through request_publication() too. Verified in a1/a2/b.

Exactly one audit line 'Book mock missed its time' per miss: save_mock-then-audit is inside missed_time() which returns immediately on second entry (release_at is now None, the guard `not mock.release_at` short-circuits). Verified by edge g (three retries, still one audit).
Library restore keeps missed_at (RestoreInput handler only toggles archived); the UI correctly still renders the mock-missed-<id> line post-restore (edge b).

success_rate.backend: 100% (19/19 edge checks; 19/19 picture_late242; 50/50 ui_picture239 includes 12 step-3 UI checks)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (desktop 1920x800 and mobile 390x844, no horizontal overflow, no failed API calls)
